notes: Opened by forcing Enigma to rez with Forged Activation Orders and then running straight into it with no code gate breaker; later ran HQ about 12 times in a row against a Corp looping Archived Memories, and never ran R&D again even after installing Gordian Blade on turn 8. Won anyway because the Corp did almost nothing.

Let a broke Corp (0-3 credits) score Project Atlas twice and Hostile Takeover out of a remote whose low-advanced Mausolus does not end the run, skipping the remote on turns 5, 7 and 9; on turns 10-13 it clicked for credits up to 23 credits instead of running, and the Corp reached 6 points before the Runner finally contested.

Good play: punished Audacity with an Archives run on turn 1, cleared the Hard-Hitting News tags against Weyland, and pressured the remote and HQ quickly. Minor risk ending turn 1 on 1 credit with 2 tags.

Installed Atman at 0 counters twice (Self-modifying Code on turn 1, Scavenge on turn 16), then sat at 0-6 credits for 14 turns running R&D through Swordsman for 1 net damage almost every turn; it twice installed Chameleon (barrier) at end of turn without using it against the single Meru Mati guarding the Oaktown that would have won it the game, and it finally ran with 3 cards in grip into a deck known to contain Snare! and was flatlined.

Sharp, aggressive remote pressure (SSL Endorsement, then SDS Drone Deployment via Dirty Laundry, then Stimhack into Mausolus for the win on turn 5); only oddity is clicking for credits on turn 3 instead of probing centrals.

Installed Atman at 0 strength and Self-modifying Code but never used SMC to fetch a fracter for the Wall of Static guarding R&D and the remote; skipped the remote while the Corp was on 0-3 credits behind unrezzed ice (turns 2 and 5) and clicked for credits about 12 times up to 28 credits while the Corp scored three Accelerated Beta Tests to win.
Short, clean game: double HQ run on turn 2 for two Private Security Forces, then Forged Activation Orders to trash Enigma and an HQ run for the win on turn 3.

Built up slowly with no runs at all on turns 1-5 and overdrew into discards on turns 5 and 7, but punished Longevity Serum through Archives and finished well with Mad Dash through Mlinzi to steal Obokata Protocol on turn 8.

Strong Account Siphon / HQ pressure, but on turns 5-6 it ran an advanced remote four times and each time took Bank Job's replacement effect for 0 credits instead of accessing the agenda (Private Security Force, later scored by the Corp); then ran into an unrezzed Enigma with no code gate breaker.

On turn 3 it spent 4 credits on Earthrise Hotel before running the remote, which left it unable to pump Paperclip through Border Control, and the Corp scored Project Atlas; Turntable swaps on turns 7 and 8 (Atlas for Hostile Takeover, GFI for Atlas) cost it a point and gave the Corp two, and it burned Stimhack facechecking HQ ice.
